CFTA formalize: actual recursive outputs now have native certificates and conditional assignments. Source head 563a92a206770c2112b79703b2bec6c43469b3fe; main 82258094c2c32bb93e517427bc649a5c7077adac unchanged after pull/fetch.

Nine new Lean modules prove OutputOrigin for every actual finite recursive output, including outputs retained before a later stop. The original finite admission produces a uniform bound, the same stable old outcome and its whole OutcomeResources. Each emitted flat output additionally retains its own Caller/full Memos, related safe ordered Packet, same-heap native correctness, Fits and guard carrier.

Done means candidates are empty. It does not imply Discharged: native pending slots can be closed recursive boundaries with empty suspended buckets. The checked initial-slot family is conditional on a genuine decoded available closed recursive value; it does not certify a whole Context or allocation history. No Haskell repair follows from that family.

A new actual flat native renderer has complete successful-old replay. Separately, explicit flat Discharged, actual successful flat rendering and checks of the actual residuals construct a satisfying assignment at the output's own heap and preserve the exact whole flat core. No successful old rendering or desired final assignment is an input. Original-input acceptance through the whole recursive/pruning trace and coverage remain open. Pruning contracts, initial semantic admission histories, discharge/render existence, unbounded convergence and physical Haskell certification also remain open.

All nine modules and Audit pass strict checking. Aggregate Audit: 4073 jobs, 79112 theorem dependency checks. Installed public readback: 31 signatures and axiom lists, 8 definitions, 71888 bytes, SHA256 301ac410be1048a3cdaafcdbb02c5b51eb48fcc108a5d38ee4da88c800463810. Only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound occur. H6 and the earlier conditional captured-rendering theorem are unchanged. Independent final source/document review is CLEAR. No Haskell source changed; FINDINGS preserves the repair handoffs and extraction-progress limitation.

Restart: lean/notes-current-recursive-outputs.md and current NEXT-PROMPT/HANDOFF/FINDINGS. The full goal remains active.
